players.bio: Angus Fraser James Gunn is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Premier League club Nottingham Forest and the Scotland national team. He has represented England at under-21 level. He began his career at his hometown club Norwich City, before joining Manchester City in 2011, eventually signing his first professional contract in 2013.
Beau Matthew Lovie Leroux (born August 31, 2003) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a midfielder for Major League Soccer club San Jose Earthquakes.

Benjamin "Benji" Kikanović (born January 6, 2000) is an American-Bosnian professional soccer player for Major League Soccer club San Jose Earthquakes. Career College and amateur Kikanović played two years of college soccer at California State University, Sacramento between 2018 and 2019, making 34 appearances, scoring 9 goals and tallying 5 assists.

Bruce Arena (born September 21, 1951) is an American soccer coach who currently serves as the head coach and sporting director of the San Jose Earthquakes. He is a member of the National Soccer Hall of Fame and the NJCAA Lacrosse Hall of Fame.

Daniel Munie (born February 10, 2000) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a defender for Major League Soccer club San Jose Earthquakes. Career Youth, college & amateur Munie attended Parkway North High School, also playing club soccer with St. Louis Scott Gallagher and later the Saint Louis FC academy.
Darius Johnson (born 15 March 2000) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for San Jose Earthquakes in Major League Soccer. Born in England, he plays for the Grenada national team.

David James Romney (born June 12, 1993) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a defender for Major League Soccer club San Jose Earthquakes. Career Romney began his professional career with LA Galaxy II, having previously played for the University of San Francisco men's soccer team and amateur club San Francisco City FC.
DeJuan Lytelle Jones (born June 24, 1997) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a defender for Major League Soccer club San Jose Earthquakes and the United States national team.

Earl William Edwards Jr. (born January 24, 1992) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a goalkeeper for Major League Soccer club San Jose Earthquakes. College and amateur Edwards spent his entire college career at UCLA, including a red-shirted year in 2010. He made a total of 61 appearances for the Bruins and finished with 19 shutouts and a 1.07 Goals Against Average.

Ian Andrew Harkes (born March 30, 1995) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a midfielder for Major League Soccer club San Jose Earthquakes. He previously played for Dundee United F.C. in The Scottish Championship and The Scottish Premier League as well as D.C. United in Major League Soccer.

Jack Jasinski is an American professional soccer player who plays as a right-back for the San Jose Earthquakes in Major League Soccer (MLS). Born on December 4, 2003, in Charlotte, North Carolina, the 22-year-old defender was selected 41st overall in the second round of the 2026 MLS SuperDraft from Princeton University.
Jamar Ricketts (born October 24, 2001) is an American professional soccer player who plays for Major League Soccer club San Jose Earthquakes.

José Luis "Jesse" González Gudiño (born May 25, 1995) is an American professional soccer player who played as a goalkeeper. Gonzalez was recruited by FC Dallas at the age of 16 and started in the academy; he was signed to a professional contract a few years later. On March 25, 2013, he signed a Homegrown Player (HGP) contract with the club, making him the 10th homegrown signing in club history.
John "Jack" Skahan (born February 7, 1998) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a midfielder for Major League Soccer club San Jose Earthquakes.
Luka Jovanović (born 20 May 2005) is an Australian professional footballer who plays as a striker for A-League Men club Adelaide United.
Max Floriani is an American professional soccer player who plays as a Defender for Major League Soccer club San Jose Earthquakes.
Nathan Donald Crockford (born September 6, 2002) is an American soccer player who plays for Major League Soccer club San Jose Earthquakes.

Nick Fernandez is an American professional soccer player who plays as a defensive midfielder for the San Jose Earthquakes in Major League Soccer (MLS). He wears the number 20 shirt. Born on 22 December 2001 in Downers Grove, Illinois, the 24-year-old was drafted 32nd overall in the second round of the 2025 MLS SuperDraft out of the University of Portland.
Nikolas Diego "Niko" Tsakiris (born June 19, 2005) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a midfielder for Major League Soccer club San Jose Earthquakes.
Noel Arthur Coleman Buck is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Major League Soccer club San Jose Earthquakes.

Nonso Adimabua is a 25-year-old Nigerian professional football player who plays as a centre-forward for Major League Soccer (MLS) club San Jose Earthquakes and its MLS NEXT Pro reserve team, San Jose Earthquakes II. Born on 7 September 2000 in Asaba, Nigeria, he stands at a commanding 1.93 metres (6'4") and operates primarily as a physical target man.

Ousseni Bouda (born 28 April 2000) is a Burkinabé footballer who currently plays for San Jose Earthquakes in Major League Soccer. Bouda was the recipient of the Gatorade National Boys Soccer Player of the Year award for the 2017–18 season. The award is a nationally recognized honor given to the best high school athlete in each sport in the United States.

Paul Marie (born 24 March 1995) is a French professional footballer who plays as a right-back and defender for Major League Soccer (MLS) club San Jose Earthquakes. Career College Born in Saint-Aubin-des-Bois, France, Marie moved to the United States as a teenager to attend college. He began at Newberry College in 2014, where he played one season of Division II soccer for the Wolves.

Preston Judd (born May 28, 1999) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a forward for Major League Soccer club San Jose Earthquakes. On January 13, 2021, Judd signed with USL Championship side Sporting Kansas City II. Judd had attended Kansas City's 2020 College Invitational Combine, for players who had missed the 2020 season due to the COVID-19 pandemic.
Reid Roberts (born December 9, 2001) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a Defender for Major League Soccer club San Jose Earthquakes.

Ronaldo Augusto Vieira Nan is a professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Major League Soccer club San Jose Earthquakes. Born in Guinea Bissau, and also holding Portuguese nationality, he is an England U21s international.

Timo Werner (born 6 March 1996) is a German professional footballer who plays as a forward for Major League Soccer club San Jose Earthquakes. Werner began his senior club career in 2013 playing for VfB Stuttgart, becoming the club's youngest debutant and youngest ever goalscorer.
Vítor Costa de Brito (born 1 July 1994) is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Major League Soccer club San Jose Earthquakes.
